validity.researcher_notes: P3160 is a real proposed pipeline by Mirage Energy Corp (CIK 0001623360). Confirmed to exist as a project proposal via Mirage Energy 2021 Annual Report (10-K for fiscal year ending 2021-07-31, filed 2022-01-21). The pipeline was described as connecting South Texas (Banquete) to Mexico (Los Ramones, Nuevo León) with a 250-mile total length and 42-inch diameter. Mirage Energy listed it as an active project through at least July 31, 2021. However, no SEC filings from Mirage Energy exist after 2022-01-21. The company appears to have ceased operations or filed no further reports post-2022. Without a dated cancellation announcement or withdrawal notice, the 'cancelled' status is inferred from project silence (no news in >4 years). Classification as transmission is consistent with the 42-inch diameter and cross-border interstate scope described in the 10-K.
